name: QueueDefinition
description: Definition of a transaction queue for distributing work items

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the queue

Description.description: Optional description of the queue's purpose

MaxNumberOfRetries.description: Maximum number of automatic retries for failed transactions

AcceptAutomaticallyRetry.description: Whether failed items are automatically requeued for retry

EnforceUniqueReference.description: Whether each item must have a unique reference string

OrganizationUnitId.description: ID of the folder in which this queue resides
